definitions.explanation: Reacting more strongly than normal to stimuli, whether physical (allergens, chemicals) or emotional (criticism, noise). Used in both medical and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}が{過敏|かびん}になっている。
{彼|かれ}は{批判|ひはん}に{対|たい}して{過敏|かびん}に{反応|はんのう}する。
{花粉|かふん}の{時期|じき}は{鼻|はな}が{過敏|かびん}になって{何|なに}もかも{匂|にお}いが{気|き}になる。
examples.english: During pollen season my nose becomes hypersensitive and every smell bothers me.

notes:
USAGE:
{過敏|かびん} can describe both physical sensitivity (allergies, skin conditions) and emotional/psychological sensitivity (overreacting to criticism or stimuli).

COMPOUNDS:
- {過敏症|かびんしょう} (hypersensitivity; allergy)
- {過敏性腸症候群|かびんせいちょうしょうこうぐん} (irritable bowel syndrome / IBS)
- {化学物質過敏症|かがくぶっしつかびんしょう} (chemical sensitivity)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過敏|かびん}に{反応|はんのう}する (to react oversensitively)
- {過敏|かびん}になる (to become hypersensitive)
- {神経|しんけい}{過敏|かびん} (nervous hypersensitivity)
